note: Completeness is computed from reporting statuses, never stored. Output per tier: universal gold/near_gold, study-type fraction, good_practice separate. No combined score. Tier membership pending the PhD lead.

computation.universal: Applicable items exclude status not_applicable and items whose not_applicable_for includes the study type. gold = all applicable items reported. near_gold = >=1 applicable item not_reported (missing list, plus not_checked list if any); missing takes precedence. unverified = none missing but >=1 could_not_check or not_yet_assessed (not_checked list with check_failure_reason). Location is never a pass condition (U1/TOP4). Paper is kept, never dropped.
computation.study_type: fraction reported / (items not not_applicable); not_yet_assessed and could_not_check are counted separately, not as misses
computation.good_practice: fraction reported, reported separately; never affects pass/fail
computation.required_secondary_tiers: (1) any required item not_reported -> near_gold. (2) else any required item could_not_check (or not_yet_assessed) -> unverified. (3) else secondary share: worst = reported / applicable (unchecked counted not reported; denominator = applicable items incl. unchecked); best = (reported + unchecked) / applicable. worst >= cutoff -> gold; best < cutoff -> near_gold (share too low); otherwise unverified. Output both shares and the missing / not_checked lists.

items.note: Route of administration is required (Shawn, TOP2). Not reported -> missing -> near_gold. Provisional pending Shawn.

clinical.note: Gold rule for RCTs only (Shawn 2026-10-31). Non-randomized interventional trials are out_of_scope: no gold rule, no comparison-group check. Observational / self-report / reviews / case reports are not_scored. Supplier stays not_applicable for clinical.

good_practice.answered: G1 (Shawn 2026-10-31): exactly storage_temperature, milled_ground, protected_from_light. Replaces V4 set; storage_duration dropped. No contamination or batch-testing fields. Recorded only, never affects any tier.
good_practice.note: Recorded only; never counts toward gold or any share.

previously_described_policy: TOP1 (Shawn, 2026-10-31, final): 'As previously described [ref]' = not_reported (not_reported_reason cited_elsewhere). Cited papers are never fetched. There is no cited_prior_paper location value.

answered.U1: Shawn, 2026-10-31: universal = strain/product name, supplier, form, major cannabinoids, all status reported for gold.
answered.TOP4: Shawn, 2026-10-31: location is never a pass condition; it is still recorded. Confirmed (Shawn, 2026-10-31): a missing (not_reported) universal item always blocks gold, no exceptions. Resolved: TOP4 applies only to items required for the study type; supplier stays not_applicable for clinical.
answered.U2: Shawn, 2026-10-31: supplier is its own field, separate from strain/product name; for clinical studies supplier is not_applicable (not required, never counted missing).
answered.V1: In vivo tier: required_always route, dose, duration, number_of_animals; secondary species, animal_strain, sex, age_or_weight, frequency, vehicle (key vehicle_solvent); secondary_cutoff default 0.80, overridable.
answered.C1: Shawn, 2026-10-31: a dose given only as a range (e.g. 5-20 mg/kg) counts as reported. 'Per protocol' counts as reported only if the paper or its cited protocol gives an actual number; otherwise dose = not_reported.
answered.C2: Shawn, 2026-10-31: vague duration terms ('chronic', 'long-term', 'acute', ...) with no actual time do not count as duration reported (duration stays not_reported). The term is kept as reporting.duration.duration_category (+ _verbatim), a filter label that never affects any tier.
answered.G1: G1 (Shawn 2026-10-31): exactly storage_temperature, milled_ground, protected_from_light. Replaces V4 set; storage_duration dropped. No contamination or batch-testing fields. Recorded only, never affects any tier.
answered.TOP1: TOP1 (Shawn, 2026-10-31, final): 'As previously described [ref]' = not_reported (not_reported_reason cited_elsewhere). Cited papers are never fetched. There is no cited_prior_paper location value.
answered.TOP3: Shawn, 2026-10-31: a numeric value without units (e.g. a dose number, no unit) = not_reported (not_reported_reason missing_units).
